name: Oddworld Anthology: The Unlikely Heroes Collection
summary:
Oddworld: Anthology is the oddest collection of all, and the complete Oddworld experience for Nintendo Switch!

Escape from a company that wants to turn you into delicious meat in the puzzle-platformer Oddworld: New ‘n’ Tasty, avoid extinction and soulless scientists in Oddworld: Munch’s Oddysee, explore the new world in Soulstorm, and become a bounty hunter with mercy in the hybrid first- and third-person shooter Oddworld: Stranger’s Wrath
